Generator.Additional Information: The generator is the heart of the wind turbine, responsible for producing the electricity. An electrical failure in the generator can result in reduced energy production and potential safety risks, as well as damage to the turbine.

Yaw System.Additional Information: The yaw system allows the wind turbine to rotate into the wind, maximizing the amount of energy it can produce. A mechanical failure in the yaw system can result in reduced energy production and potential safety risks, as well as damage to the turbine.

Control System.Additional Information: The control system monitors and controls the wind turbine's operation, ensuring that it is producing the maximum amount of electricity possible.
